scope: Independent actual implementation review plus inspection of the completed ordinary main build and finite source/data receipts. This is main acceptance only.

runtime_findings.finding: Ten-family explicit SPI kind/version/instance/IRQ/peer qualification; old F030/A030/L083 DMA remains separate.
Ordinary borrowed peripheral/pins retained; only phase lives in owner; static state holds active/error/waker only.
Unpolled calls have no side effects; all polled entries including empties settle retained work; cancelled/forgotten RX is discarded before new index zero.
AwaitRx is recorded before DR write, and no next frame launches before preceding RX is consumed.
At most one DR read and one DR write per poll, with one shared read budget for predecessor/preparation/current receive and no buffer-length loop.
Masked error-first idle checks precede width restoration and RXNE-gated stale drain; no old unbounded prepare/wait loop in async polls.
Register waiter, mask, observe error/readiness, arm exact wait/error sources, recheck; ready-over-budget work self-wakes.
Active guard before MMIO, bounded ISR/IER snapshots, first-error latch, local mask and wake outside borrow; no ISR DR or caller access.
Successful final result requires consumed RX and masked error-free TXE=1/BUSY=0; BUSY self-wakes with no deadline or low-power claim.
First latched error retained; ModeFault/Overrun/ChipSelectFault/Underrun snapshot priority preserved; task uses disabled destructive recovery and returns error.
Generic blocking entry including empties first makes bounded settlement; pending reports PioBusy before new data.
Busy guard preserves pending errors without recovery/ICR/configuration writes; second error-aware check after validation.
Pure preflight precedes stale-state retirement; retirement precedes Flex pin mutation/reset/configuration; blocking replacement remains inactive.
Local mask/inactive fence precedes disable/gate/disconnect; no PIO leaked pins, RX/BUSY wait or graceful completion claim.
Full SPI23 association required for both SPI2 and SPI3; dispatch both, skip inactive before MMIO, no shared disable/unpend.
All five real byte trait methods and empty forms; exact selected packages; both SPI23 peers alive; error paths keep CS selected; no hardware claim.

diagnostics.attribution: Existing generated RCC LSE constants on L010/L011; no SPI PIO diagnostic. Other 28 rows have zero compiler warnings. Raw Cargo JSON and stderr were both inspected.

limitations: No firmware was flashed or executed.
No HAL tests, synthetic lifecycle probes, host models or new aggregate CI matrix were added or executed as part of this review.
The seven recorded source/data commands are the existing approved finite gates, not on-silicon behavior tests.
ELF static RAM extent includes linked allocation/alignment, not measured dynamic stack high-water.
Build success does not prove hardware IRQ timing, throughput, electrical behavior, graceful early abort, RF coexistence, low-power behavior or finite liveness.
Successful flush is required before changing CS after cancellation; error recovery, Drop and reconstruction remain destructive.
